inventions.invention_title: Progressive MCP Tool Discovery & RFC 8693 OAuth 2.1 On-Behalf-Of (OBO) Token Exchange
inventions.discovery_lineage: Christian Posta (LI-11) · Raju Dandigam (LI-56) · Model Context Protocol Spec
inventions.customer_pain_point: Enterprise PoCs stall at security review because mounting 50+ MCP servers dumps 55,000+ tool-schema tokens into the prompt and shares static service-account keys across users.
inventions.customer_success_prescription: Deploy a Vertex AI ADK Gateway that indexes tool schemas in vector search (loading only the Top-4 tools per turn) and exchanges the caller's OIDC JWT for a downscoped RFC 8693 OBO token per tool call.
inventions.quantified_value_kpis: -97.5% prompt token overhead (55,240 -> 1,380 tokens) · 94.2% tool routing accuracy · 0 shared service-account secrets
